column1: # O6: the translation contexts of the interface (docs/qt/localisation.md, "Keys and migration").
# A string is keyed by the surface it belongs to, not by the QML file or C++ class that holds it, so moving
# code keeps its translations. QML: a file of one surface sets `pragma Translator: "<context>"` and calls qsTr;
# a string of another surface in it calls qsTranslate("<context>", ...). C++: QCoreApplication::translate
# and QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP("<context>", ...); never tr(), whose context is the class.
# The lint (ctest hikari_i18n_contexts_are_semantic) fails on a context missing here.
# HikariSub.Automation.Gettext (aegisub.gettext's catalog) is not listed: no interface string uses it.
